strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart with a bulk discount (10% off at 10+ items summed over line quantities), the SAVE5 coupon ($5 off after the bulk discount, floored at $0, any other code refused) and shipping ($4.99, free when discounted goods reach $50, nothing for an empty cart). All of it lives in pure functions in src/cart.js (cartTotal, bulkDiscount), so Vitest unit tests prove every rule at its boundaries. Reading the code shows bulkDiscount uses `itemCount > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so a cart of exactly 10 items gets no discount, contrary to AC1 and the function's own doc comment; that case will be kept as an expected failure and reported as a defect.
inScope: cartTotal and bulkDiscount in src/cart.js: bulk discount threshold, coupon order/floor/refusal, shipping threshold, empty cart
outOfScope: Any UI or API checkout flow (the repo has only the pricing module)
assumptions: Coupon codes are case-sensitive: only exactly 'SAVE5' is accepted (code uses an exact key lookup; the ticket says any other code is refused).
Totals are compared as numbers rounded to cents, as cartTotal returns them.
Tests import thresholds/amounts only implicitly via expected totals computed from the ticket's numbers, so a changed constant that breaks the ticket's rule fails the test.

risks.description: Off-by-one at the bulk threshold: code uses > 10 instead of >= 10, so exactly 10 items get no discount.
risks.mitigation: TC1 asserts the discount at exactly 10 items (expected failure + defect); TC2/TC3 pin 9 and 11.

risks.description: Coupon applied before the bulk discount gives a different total.
risks.mitigation: TC4 uses amounts where the two orders differ (94 vs 94.5).

risks.description: Shipping threshold evaluated on subtotal rather than discounted goods.
risks.mitigation: TC9 and TC10 use carts whose subtotal is >= $50 but discounted goods are < $50.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer than 10 gets none.
Coupon SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount; goods never cost less than $0; any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when goods after discounts cost $50 or more, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs $0.

defects.title: Cart of exactly 10 items gets no bulk discount
defects.description: AC1: a cart with 10 or more items should get 10% off. bulkDiscount (src/cart.js:22) uses `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so exactly 10 items get no discount. The function's own doc comment says "at least this many". Expected: cartTotal of 10 items at $10 = 90. Actual: 100. Fix: use `>=`.
defects.evidence: cartTotal([{price:10,quantity:6},{price:10,quantity:4}]) returns 100, not 90; test marked it.fails passes in the counted run (attempt 0).
